sources.snippet: Several key developments have shaped the evolution of deep CNNs. LeNet-5 [1] introduced the basic CNN structure with convolutional, pooling, and fully connected layers. AlexNet [2] demonstrated the power of deeper networks combined with GPU acceleration, achieving breakthrough results on ImageNet with an eight-layer model.
